description: Defines classes and structures for managing volume curves in Android audio policy, including CurvePoint, VolumeCurve, and VolumeCurves, with methods for volume index conversion, curve management, and dumping information.

classes.name: CurvePoint
classes.description: Represents a point on a volume curve with an index and attenuation in millibels.

classes.name: VolumeCurve
classes.description: Represents a volume curve for a specific device category, containing multiple CurvePoints.

classes.name: VolumeCurves
classes.description: Manages multiple VolumeCurve instances indexed by device category, supporting volume index management and curve switching.

methods.name: volIndexToDb
methods.description: Converts a volume index to decibels based on the curve's points.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs the details of the volume curve or curves for debugging.

methods.name: getDeviceCategory
methods.description: Returns the device category associated with a VolumeCurve.

methods.name: initVolume
methods.description: Initializes volume index range for VolumeCurves.

methods.name: getCurvesFor
methods.description: Retrieves the VolumeCurve for a specific device category.

methods.name: getVolumeIndex
methods.description: Gets the current volume index for a set of device types.

methods.name: canBeMuted
methods.description: Indicates if the volume stream can be muted.

methods.name: clearCurrentVolumeIndex
methods.description: Clears current volume indices.

methods.name: addCurrentVolumeIndex
methods.description: Sets the current volume index for a specific device.

methods.name: getVolumeIndexMin
methods.description: Returns the minimum volume index.

methods.name: getVolumeIndexMax
methods.description: Returns the maximum volume index.

methods.name: hasVolumeIndexForDevice
methods.description: Checks if a volume index exists for a specific device.

methods.name: switchCurvesFrom
methods.description: Switches current curves from a reference set of curves.

methods.name: restoreOriginVolumeCurve
methods.description: Restores original volume curves.

methods.name: getOriginVolumeCurve
methods.description: Retrieves the original volume curve for a device category.

methods.name: setVolumeCurve
methods.description: Sets the volume curve for a device category.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new VolumeCurve to the collection.

methods.name: volIndexToDb
methods.description: Converts a volume index to decibels for a specific device category.

methods.name: addAttributes
methods.description: Adds audio attributes to the volume curve.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns the attributes associated with the volume curve.

methods.name: addStreamType
methods.description: Adds a stream type to the volume curve.

methods.name: getStreamTypes
methods.description: Returns the stream types associated with the volume curve.
